config.distribution: equal-weight discrete empirical measure at the three original member predictions
config.score: exact positive-loss CRPS of empirical distribution, denominator M^2, lower is better
config.calibration_transform: none: interval calibration does not define a full CDF

nll.reason: No continuous predictive density has been declared; the empirical measure is atomic.

config.invalid_members: any nonfinite member invalidates the fixed three-member score; retain denominator
config.aggregation: origins within episode, equal-weight episodes; ensemble is one predictor, no pseudo seed replicates

crps: CRPS of original finite empirical distribution, not of validation-calibrated intervals

nll.reason: No continuous predictive density has been declared; the empirical measure is atomic.

member_dependence: Different training seeds on shared data, not IID posterior draws
units: CRPS uses temperature units Celsius, not Celsius squared
interpretation: marginal one-variable scores, not joint multivariate or trajectory distribution scores
